title: GameConfig
description: Server-authoritative match settings. PUBLIC: part of every room projection so all clients can display the rules. Only the host may change it and only while the room is in LOBBY; the server validates every value.

impostorCount.description: Number of impostors. Additionally validated against the player count at game start: impostors must be strictly fewer than crewmates (max = floor((players - 1) / 2)).

tasksPerCrewmate.description: Tasks generated for every crewmate at game start.

killCooldownMs.description: Minimum time in ms between two kills. 0 disables the cooldown.

discussionDurationMs.description: Duration of the DISCUSSION phase of a meeting before voting opens. 0 skips discussion.

votingDurationMs.description: Maximum duration of the VOTING phase. Voting ends early once all alive players have voted.

confirmEjects.description: When true, meeting results include the ejected player's name; otherwise only the fact that someone was ejected is revealed.

anonymousVoting.description: When true, the vote tally is omitted from meeting results.
